scope: Complete V26 development windows compared with previously sealed V25/V24/V23-native evidence; different revision and realized demand, not a same-version native comparison or causal speedup.

background_writer_timing.semantics: Measured processing samples completed between writer snapshots. Producer timestamps, queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Samples may span a boundary; cumulative maxima are not window maxima. No multiplication by the sampling interval, full-window cost, GIL attribution, GPU stall or JCT saving is inferred.

v26.cuda_graph_semantics: Engine completion result can_run_cuda_graph, paired with this batch. Absent legacy flags remain unknown; batch size alone does not prove replay. Worker intervals include scheduler/result processing and are not kernel timings.

prefill_geometry.semantics: Completed worker intervals, not CUDA kernel timings. Cohorts require native prepared prefix/extend lengths for every batch row; they match batch size, 512-token total-work bins and 2048-token mean-prefix bins. Legacy missing fields or zero defaults do not establish zero prefill work. Partial attributed batches retain unknown total work.

periodic_decode_graph_log.flag_source: GenerationBatchResult.can_run_cuda_graph -> process_batch_result_decode -> metrics_reporter.report_decode_stats for that completed batch.
periodic_decode_graph_log.semantics: Periodic decode log samples, not all batches or kernel timings. Second-resolution timestamps represent a one-second bucket; samples straddling the requested half-open window are excluded. No flag is backfilled into runtime_audit batches or extrapolated to unsampled batches. Missing logs and observed zero samples differ.

reference_report.semantics: Prior sealed measurements reused without rescanning historical data.

gpu_restore_dependency_wait.semantics: Sampled CUDA-stream native layer-dependency waits including event overhead; not all H2D, not request queue delay or an oracle JCT bound.

measurement_notes: Live generation can produce different request traces in each policy.
No incomplete-run JCT or completed-only workflow comparison is included.
Decode token deltas belong to their completed worker batch's window.
LLM output lengths separately belong to the request completion window.
Worker intervals are scheduler/worker wall intervals, not CUDA kernel durations.
Input/cache token counts belong to submission, not the actual GPU-service window.
Transfer payloads and measured batch durations belong to the physical submission window.
Only completed transfer receipts are included; live pending batches are not credited.
Physical batch durations are counted once, even when payload sources share a batch.
JOIN/tool source bytes require separate event-boundary and first-reuse checks to prove anticipation.
Restore dependency waits are sampled CUDA layer waits, not per-request queue wait or all-batch totals.
GPU utilization is the mean of monitor samples within each window.
A trailing unfinished JSONL record is excluded from this read.

limitations: V25 GIL profiler overlaps 1015.164-1041.164 seconds, outside these windows.
Worker intervals and exclusive Python wall are not CUDA kernel time or removable JCT.
The V97 residency optimization is isolated and not deployed in V26.
